jobs.title: Product Manager Supply Chain & Transport - F/H
jobs.description: Le Product Management, c’est notre ADN. Chez Hubvisory, tu ne te contentes pas de gérer un backlog : tu deviens la référence produit incontournable pour accompagner nos clients grands comptes sur les produits digitaux qui tiennent leur chaîne d’approvisionnement debout. Référencement transporteurs, flux maritimes, routiers et ferroviaires, données critiques, maîtrise des coûts réels. Des sujets denses, peu spectaculaires vus de loin, et parmi les plus structurants qu’un Product Manager puisse porter. Ce que tu fais concrètement : Tu pars du terrain avant de concevoir. Cartographie des flux de données, entretiens avec les coordinateurs transport parfois répartis sur plusieurs pays, identification des vrais irritants. Tu traduis ce qui remonte en parcours cibles, pas en liste de demandes. Tu portes une vision à deux ou trois ans. Tu construis la roadmap d’une plateforme de référencement et de pilotage : automatisation des appels d’offres, gestion des quotas, prévision des délais d’acheminement. Tu décides ce qu’on construit, et ce qu’on laisse tomber. Tu prends la donnée en main. Modèles interconnectés, qualité de la donnée, écarts entre coûts réels transporteurs et refacturation interne. Tu interprètes toi-même les indicateurs, tu structures des hypothèses, tu mesures pour décider, pas pour afficher. Tu pilotes le cadrage et la delivery. Briefs produit et scénarios d’usage pour ta squad technique, animation des rituels, validation de la conformité à chaque jalon, mise en service et formation des utilisateurs. Un outil historique ne disparaît que si le nouveau tient vraiment la route. Tu mesures l’impact. Réduction de la charge manuelle des équipes transport, fiabilisation des délais, tenue des coûts. Tu définis les KPI et les OKR qui comptent et tu les défends. Tu participes à la vie d’Hubvisory. Tu consolides ta posture de consultant, tu partages tes retours d’expérience et tu évolues, selon tes aspirations, vers des rôles de Product Leader ou Manager Conseil. Tu as

jobs.title: Cloud Engineer - Quantum Computing (f/m/d)
jobs.description: eleQtron develops and operates full-stack quantum computers based on trapped-ion technology. Quantum computing is a new computing paradigm rapidly approaching commercial viability. Our unique approach combines laser-cooled trapped ions with microwave control and tailored magnetic fields. Our next-generation computing machines under development will be able to find solutions to problems that are out of reach today, thus enabling new innovative products and services for a brighter future. We are looking for a Cloud Engineer (m/f/d) to join us in Hamburg or Siegen and build and operate the scalable, secure cloud platform that connects users with our trapped-ion quantum computers. jobs.description: Elite is the trusted automation platform for law firm operations across most of the world’s largest and most successful law firms. Elite has guided firms through every technology shift and today delivers the only cloud-native SaaS platform that unifies financial, invoice, time, and data management into a single system of action. With embedded AI, predictive analytics, and integrated payments, Elite’s products enable firms to shorten billing cycles, reduce write-offs, and unlock firm-wide insights, making financial operations the foundation for law firm innovation and growth. Learn more at elite.com. Position Overview   Elite is seeking a Senior Sales Engineer to lead complex, enterprise solution engagements across the global legal market.   This role is designed for a strategic, business-minded pre-sales professional who thrives in high-visibility environments and operates as a trusted advisor to executive stakeholders and a collaborative partner to Sales, Product, and leadership teams.   We are seeking a candidate with strong enterprise software, ERP, financial systems, or SaaS experience who brings exceptional business acumen, executive communication skills, and the ability to quickly master complex platforms. Experience within the legal industry or Practice Management Systems is valuable but not required.   In this role, you will shape deal strategy, guide executive discovery, and influence buying decisions by connecting client business priorities to differentiated, outcome-driven solutions. A key focus includes supporting firms through digital transformation initiatives, including on-premise to cloud migrations.     Senior Sales Engineers are expected to elevate pre-sales standards, model value-based engagement, and positively influence team culture through collaboration, professionalism, and leadership without authority.   Work Arrangement: ​ Remote ​   This role requires the individual to be based in ​ UK Time Zone

jobs.title: Senior Industrialization & Supply Chain Manager (f/m/d).
jobs.description: About TACTILIA At TACTILIA, we are building the industry-ready robotic hand that closes one of the biggest gaps in Physical AI. Spun out of SCHUNK, the global market leader in gripping technology, we combine a decade of robotic-hand expertise and real industrial access with the speed and ambition of a deep-tech startup. This isn't a research project waiting for its first customer. We already have a product, customers are ready to use it, and we are launching now. Your work will directly shape the electronics, actuators, and embedded systems that make that possible. You will join at the moment when the hard engineering questions become real product decisions: how do we make a highly capable robotic hand reliable, manufacturable, serviceable, and simple enough to deploy on a real shop floor? The Role As Senior Industrialization & Supply Chain Manager you will take ownership of the industrialization perspective throughout the product development process. Working closely with R&D, engineering and external manufacturing partners, you will ensure that manufacturing considerations are integrated into product design from the earliest development stages. You will challenge existing design decisions where necessary, identify more suitable manufacturing technologies and processes, and drive the transition from engineering concepts and prototypes to manufacturable, scalable products. This is a key role for someone who enjoys operating at the intersection of engineering, product development and manufacturing – and who is equally comfortable discussing technical trade-offs with R&D engineers, negotiating with suppliers and engaging directly with people on the production floor. Durch die Übernahme von Autovia (AutoExpress und Evo) haben wir unsere Reichweite verdoppelt: 10 Mio. YouTube-Abonnenten, 1,2 Mio. Magazinverkäufe und mehr als 350 Mio. jährliche Online-Leser. Mit beratungsorientiertem Verkauf , gezielten Demos und viel Telefonpower sorgst du für Carwow Begeisterung. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit dem Account-Management zusammen, um langfristige Partnerschaften aufzubauen. DEINE AUFGABEN Gewinnung neuer Händler und Aktivierung auf der Sell-my-Car-Plattform (Gebote & Käufe). Neukundengewinnung durch Kaltakquise und Bearbeitung von Inbound-Leads – primär telefonisch, bei Bedarf auch durch Vor-Ort-Termine. Identifikation und Entwicklung von Cross- und Upselling-Potenzialen (z. B. Transport, Wallet, Finanzierungen und weitere Services). Durchführung überzeugender Pitches – vom Geschäftsführer bis zum Einzelunternehmer. Pflege und Dokumentation aller Aktivitäten im CRM (z. B. Salesforce). DEIN PROFIL Hinweis: Niemand erfüllt alle Anforderungen zu 100 %. Wenn du dich stark mit der Rolle identifizierst, freuen wir uns trotzdem auf deine Bewerbung. jobs.title: Account Manager (m/w/d)
jobs.description: Werde Account Manager (m/w/d) mit Fokus Digital Media bei Carwow in München. Du verkaufst unsere digitalen Mediaprodukte YouTube, Meta und Data an Automobilhersteller, Partner und Mediaagenturen und begleitest die Kampagnen von der Buchung bis zur Aussteuerung. Du bist dir nicht ganz sicher, ob die Position zu dir passt? Bewirb dich und lass es uns gemeinsam herausfinden. Unsere Mission Carwow ist Europas führende Plattform für den Autowechsel. Wir verändern, wie Menschen Autos kaufen, verkaufen und leasen. Mit Technologie, Medien und Automotive Expertise haben wir uns von einer reinen Bewertungsplattform zu einem der größten Online-Marktplätze entwickelt. Unsere Reichweite geht weit über die eigene Plattform hinaus: 10 Mio. YouTube Abonnenten und mehr als 350 Mio. Online Leser pro Jahr in der Gruppe. Genau diese Reichweite und unsere Daten machen wir jetzt für Werbekunden auch außerhalb von Carwow nutzbar. Dein Impact @ Carwow Du baust die Säule Digital Media, Audiences und Data im deutschen OEM & Media Team aus. Unsere Brand Partnerships Manager:innen verkaufen Retail Media auf der Plattform. Du sorgst dafür, dass Carwow auch in den Mediaplänen der Agenturen fest gesetzt ist. Dafür hast du drei Produkte im Gepäck. Du schnürst daraus Pakete, die zu den Zielen der Partner passen und verbindest sie mit unserem Retail Media Angebot zu einer durchgängigen Media Story bis zum Kauf. So wächst ein noch junger Umsatzstrom zu einem festen Standbein, und du prägst ihn von Anfang an mit. YouTube: Bewegtbildkampagnen im Carwow Umfeld und mit Carwow Zielgruppen, von Awareness bis Klick Meta: Kampagnen auf Facebook und Instagram, ausgesteuert auf Menschen, die gerade nachweislich ein Auto suchen Data: Datenberatung auf Basis der Carwow Daten, verbunden mit unserem Verständnis des deutschen Automarkts Und neue Produkte: Weitere Formate und Ideen, die wir gerade entwickeln. Du bringst ein, was Kunden und Agenturen brauchen, und führst neue Produkte in den Markt ein Deine Aufgaben

jobs.title: Senior Brand Designer
jobs.description: Senior Brand Designer OUR MISSION To become the car-changing destination of choice. By combining technology, media and deep automotive expertise, we've turned how people buy, sell, advertise and lease cars on its head. What started as a simple reviews site is now one of the largest online car-changing destinations in Europe. Last year alone we grew over 50% with nearly £3bn worth of cars bought on site, while £1.8bn of cars were listed for sale through our Sell My Car service. In 2024 we went big and acquired Autovia - creators of AutoExpress and Evo magazines - doubling our audience overnight. Together we now have one of the biggest YouTube channels in the world with almost 10m subscribers and over 1.1 billion annual views, while we sell 1.2 million print copies of our magazines and have an annual web content reach over 350million. And we’re a long way from done! BRAND CREATIVE @ CARWOW Brand Creative is the central creative studio for all brands within the Carwow Group. We’re an ambitious team who thrive on storytelling, craft and collaboration. We bring our portfolio of brands to life across every channel; from large-scale campaigns to social-first paid marketing creative, events, brand identity, commercial initiatives and internal culture-building. We move quickly, adapt often and work closely with colleagues across the whole business. Due to the scale up nature of the business you’ll enjoy a unique mix of variety, ownership and creative exploration. YOUR MISSION Your mission is to elevate how our brands show up visually; taking ownership of everything from early creative concepts to final delivery across a wide mix of channels. As the sole permanent designer in the team, you will play a central role in shaping how we communicate visually, balancing conceptual thinking with hands-on craft, and ensuring our brands remain consistent, recognisable and creatively ambitious. Right now it's the opposite: people value their car in one place, search for the next one in another, and manage the handover somewhere else, much of it on the web and most of it forgotten between car changes. The Carwow app is our most direct relationship with those customers, and today it is nowhere near what it could be. We are reimagining it. If we can give people a reason to open Carwow between car changes, understand what they drive and what they want next, and make the moment of changing effortless, the app becomes the place UK drivers start. This role is the product voice at the table for that: setting the direction for what we build and working day to day with design and engineering to build it. This is also a moment where AI changes what's possible. The best consumer apps of the next few years won't be lists with filters; they will understand you and act on your behalf. jobs.description: Role : Founding Design Engineer (Senior / Staff) Company : CodeSpeak Location : London, on-site. Ideally you already live in London. Candidates based elsewhere are welcome to apply, and remote is possible for a very strong candidate, but UK-based candidates come first. Candidates with a Global Talent visa, granted or in process, are a good fit. Job Type : Full-time About CodeSpeak Agents write more code every month. Human brains stay the same. CodeSpeak is building a program model that sits one level above code, so people can see how a program works and changes over time without reading much of it. The goal is to give control back to the developer: you think about architecture, and the routine goes away. CodeSpeak was founded by Andrey Breslav, the creator of Kotlin, which millions of developers use daily. Around him is a team that has built the tools other engineers rely on, at Google, Databricks, Perplexity, JetBrains, Sourcegraph, and Elastic. When it comes to program analysis and developer tooling, these are some of the best people in the world. CodeSpeak is backed by Accel and by funds that also invested in Hugging Face and Mistral, and funding covers several years. Here is the open problem. The team has a fair idea of what the program model should look like. It does not yet know how to visualise it. As Founding Design Engineer you will decide how it looks, then build it and ship it. The core engineering team has just been hired, and nobody on it has design-engineering skills. You are the missing piece. CodeSpeak is a UK company. It has no business in Russia and no ties to Russian companies. It is still testing which problems it can solve best, so priorities may shift. What you are expected to do: Design and delivery Own how people interact with CodeSpeak: in the CLI, on the web and on any future platform. Design the interfaces yourself. jobs.description: About Hexa Hexa (formerly eFounders) gives entrepreneurs the best chances to build outstanding companies. We have created 60+ companies (including 3 unicorns) with a combined valuation of over $5 billion, among them Aircall, Spendesk, Front, Swan and Yousign. We go from idea to working hardware with small teams and lean budgets, against legacy players with hundreds of engineers and decade-long programs. AI is now the biggest lever we have to widen that gap, today by speeding up how we build, and tomorrow by shaping what kind of companies we build. jobs.title: Head of Engineering | xpate
jobs.description: Role: Head of Engineering Company: xpate Location: London or remote Job Type: Full-time About xpate xpate has been a card acquirer since 2019. It combines acquiring and banking for B2B clients only, with €100M+ in annual revenue. About 100 people work there, around 15 of them in engineering. HQ is in London, and the team is spread across Latvia, Cyprus, Serbia and Singapore. The business is changing. xpate is moving from direct sales to distribution through platforms and partners: embedded finance and Payfac-as-a-Service. The platform has to change with it. Tooling, data flow, processes and the release cycle all need a rebuild, and much of the workflow is still tracked by hand. xpate also wants to become AI-native. Guardrails go around the core – the data layer and financial data – so it can’t be lost, rewritten or broken. Everything else runs through an agentic harness on top, so non-engineering teams can build their own tools by prompting agents. What you will do Lead the platform and organizational transformation from the inside, together with the current team. Own the whole technical picture: infrastructure, architecture and vendors. Replace the traditional PM → engineer handoff. Test the idea that engineering and product can work as one, with engineers talking directly to the business and domain experts. Move code writing to LLMs with automated QA. Start where mistakes are cheap and reach the critical financial components later. Hire engineers who talk to people and ask questions, not only write code. You can bring in 1–2 people who share the vision. Focus on internal efficiency. The business sets the direction – the job is not to set a product or market vision of your own. First 6 months Months 1–3: bring all data flow – customer, financial and manual – into one clear perimeter. The role has been created because both organizations are scaling fast and their leaders' time is the scarcest resource. You will own the leaders' calendars, communications, travel, and meeting preparation end to end and go further: coordinating cross-functional initiatives, running leadership rituals, and supporting high-stakes external moments such as customer and partner engagements, roadshows, and board or investor touchpoints. This is a role with real ownership where you will design the processes, dashboards, and ways of working that keep two distinct organizations running smoothly. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description: Our Mission: Scope automates the data collection that's slowing down the physical world. Standards are vital for the safety of our infrastructure. Spending hours manually documenting them is not. Dave is an inspector. Today he’s climbing through one of Europe’s biggest chemical plants, looking for the corrosion that could shut the whole site down, with a notebook and pen in hand. Tomorrow, he’ll spend even longer on the part of the job he hates: turning those scribbles into a report. We’re building the AI-native data collection layer for the 2 billion field workers like Dave. Scope radically simplifies how inspectors collect data in the field, make decisions, and produce reports. Along the way, we’re building the largest dataset on the condition of the built world and the decisions experts make about it. It’s a $2T market and we’re just getting started. We're growing rapidly, and already work with 7 of the top 10 companies in the space. Our customers inspect facilities and products for companies including AstraZeneca and SpaceX. We take pride in our talent density, and have assembled a best-in-class team: acquired and future founders, people from institutions like Imperial, Carnegie Mellon and Oxford, and from firms like Palantir, Goldman Sachs and Flexport . Since launching from Entrepreneurs First in 2024, we've raised an oversubscribed $20m round led by Index Ventures , the firm behind Figma, Revolut and Wiz, with over 100 unicorns backed to date. About the role Real product ownership. You’ll go on site with inspectors, decide what matters, design it, ship it, and see whether it worked. The hard, interesting problems in AI. Field data is messy: voice notes, photos, video, half-finished sentences recorded in a chemical plant with no signal. Turning that into a report an expert will sign is a context-engineering problem nobody has solved well yet. A small team that ships fast . jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer (Frontend)
jobs.description: Op zoek naar een werkplek waar jouw ideeën het verschil maken en waar je op niveau kan sparren met een team van ambitieuze developers? Als Software Engineer bij IXON werk je aan een modern cloudplatform dat door duizenden machinebouwers wereldwijd wordt gebruikt. Geen remote eilandjes of kortlopende projecten, maar samen bouwen aan een product waar onze klanten fan van zijn. Klaar om impact te maken? Hier krijg jij energie van Binnen jouw rol als Software Engineer werk je niet aan een statische applicatie, maar aan een continu evoluerend cloudplatform met een diversiteit aan functionaliteiten. Samen met je team ben je verantwoordelijk voor het hart van de IXON Cloud: van complexe autorisatiestructuren tot een naadloze gebruikerservaring. Het doel? Onze klanten hun beheerprocessen zo efficiënt mogelijk laten uitvoeren. Om dat voor elkaar te krijgen, werk je met een moderne tech stack die onder andere bestaat uit Angular en TypeScript. Je krijgt de vrijheid om actief mee te beslissen over technische keuzes die ervoor zorgen dat onze applicaties niet alleen vandaag snel en strak draaien, maar ook op de lange termijn schaalbaar en onderhoudbaar blijven. Wat je concreet gaat doen: Je pakt de verantwoordelijkheid, en draagt zorg voor jouw kwalitatief sterke code; Je bent een sparringpartner voor je collega’s en om features technisch uit te diepen; Je tilt graag ons front-end delivery proces naar een hoger niveau, op gebied van observability, testing en deployment Je krijgt de ruimte voor PoC’s en research spikes om de nieuwste technologieën te valideren voor ons platform. Dit maakt jou succesvol in deze rol Jij bent een Software Engineer die gelooft dat een interface pas écht goed is wanneer de logica erachter vlekkeloos werkt. Frontend is jouw passie, maar je snapt ook wat er in de backend gebeurt. Dit maakt je een belangrijke schakel in ons multidisciplinaire Scrum team. Je werkt iteratief, leert van feedback en streeft voortdurend naar verbetering. Bovendien inspireer

jobs.title: Eerste lijns system engineer
jobs.description: IT Medewerker – Eerste Lijns Service Engineer Ben jij die IT-held die energie krijgt van het helpen van mensen, houdt van virtuele omgevingen en SaaS-oplossingen, en een passie heeft voor techniek? Dan zouden we zomaar eens een match kunnen zijn. Wie zoeken we? We zijn op zoek naar een Eerste Lijns Service Engineer / Servicedesk Medewerker die klanten op een vriendelijke én deskundige manier verder helpt. Je bent het eerste aanspreekpunt bij IT-vragen of problemen . Zo weet je bijvoorbeeld wat het verschil is tussen een TAC en TAC 2 LAN netwerk of je kan rechten correct toewijzen in SharePoint. Je registreert en bewaakt meldingen in het systeem en zorgt voor een tijdige opvolging. Daarnaast weet precies hoe je iemand geruststelt, duidelijk communiceert en snel tot de kern van het probleem komt. Tot slot wordt je soms ook betrokken bij installatie van hardware en software migraties. Een diverse en uitdagende functie dus. Of je nu net van school komt of al wat meters hebt gemaakt in de IT: we horen graag van je. Wie zijn wij? Welkom bij Progression IT . Wij zijn een hecht en ambitieus IT-bedrijf uit Terneuzen, Zeeland. Al sinds 2005 helpen we onze klanten met slimme, veilige en toekomstgerichte IT-oplossingen. We doen dat met een enthousiast team van 25 collega’s – stuk voor stuk vakmensen met hart voor hun werk én voor elkaar. Onze focus ligt op cloud- en hybride omgevingen. We werken met moderne tools en technologieën en zijn ISO27001-gecertificeerd. Dat betekent dat veiligheid bij ons geen bijzaak is, maar standaard in alles wat we doen. En minstens zo belangrijk: naast hard werken, vinden we het ook belangrijk om lol te hebben. Zo lunchen we dagelijks samen (op kosten van de baas), ligt er altijd vers fruit klaar, en sporten we wekelijks onder begeleiding van een personal trainer. Een of twee keer per jaar trekken we eropuit voor een teamuitje – gewoon, omdat het gezellig is. Wat ga je doen? 🔹 Klanten telefonisch en op afstand ondersteunen (±70%) 🔹 Complexere IT

Volg je het laatste nieuws en wil je een bijdrage leveren aan een overheidsinstantie met grote maatschappelijke relevantie? Heb je affiniteit met wetenschappelijke artikelen en statistiek? Dit is jouw uitdaging Bij het CBS vormt statistisch onderzoek de basis voor alle media-uitingen. Bij het vertaalbureau komen diverse verzoeken binnen vanuit de gehele organisatie. De Engelstalige website vervult een belangrijke rol in het verspreiden van informatie onder niet-Nederlandstaligen. Je gaat aan de slag met het vertalen en reviseren van content voor de CBS-website. Je maakt gebruik van vertaaltools (onder andere MemoQ). Omdat je gelijktijdig aan meerdere publicaties werkt, leer je een goede planning te maken en ervaar je hoe het is om te werken met deadlines. Je schakelt met opdrachtgevers, een extern vertaalbureau en raadpleegt referentiemateriaal. Onze producties zijn te vinden op https://www.cbs.nl/en-gb Dit is jouw stageplek bij CBS Den Haag Je komt in een klein team en wordt intensief begeleid. Er wordt nauw samengewerkt met o.a. het redactieteam en collega's van logistiek en planning. Daarnaast is er contact met diverse afdelingen. Het vertaalbureau levert per maand zo'n 40 producten af, waaronder nieuwsberichten, webpagina's, corporate artikelen, brieven en presentaties. Dit breng jij mee Je volgt een opleiding tot vertaler met als studierichting Engels, of hebt een bachelor in Engels en bent bezig met een master Vertaalkunde. Je werkt graag samen, houdt overzicht en kunt goed omgaan met verschillende taken en veranderingen.

Wil jij een veilige en moderne generieke technische IT-infrastructuur ontwikkelen en onderhouden? En zorg jij ervoor dat de dagelijkse operatie veilig en efficiënt verloopt? Dan zijn we op zoek naar jou! Waar jij het verschil maakt Als Productmanager Data en Webdiensten ben je verantwoordelijk voor de ontwikkeling en realisatie van de productroadmap en begeleid je de processen die nodig zijn om onze producten en diensten conform de geldende kaders te realiseren. Samen met 13 collega's werk je aan het dagelijks operationeel houden en verder ontwikkelen van onze technische IT-dienstverlening. Een belangrijke ontwikkeling is de verdere uitbreiding van selfservice, onder andere door de inzet van Infrastructure as Code en het via API's ontsluiten van onze diensten. Daarbij staan veiligheid, compliance en efficiëntie centraal. C'est une école d'excellence où chacun a la possibilité de révéler son plein potentiel et de contribuer à relever les défis de demain. Classée parmi les meilleures écoles d'ingénieurs de France et reconnue à l'international, notre école, membre de l' Institut Mines-Télécom , forme les talents de demain tout en s'engageant activement face aux grands enjeux industriels, numériques et environnementaux. En nous rejoignant, vous intégrez une communauté de 500 membres du personnel et 2 500 étudiants, et participez à un projet ambitieux : allier excellence académique, recherche de pointe et impact sociétal positif. L'Institut Mines-Télécom rassemble les plus grandes Écoles françaises pour relever les grands défis industriels, numériques, énergétiques et environnementaux. Avec ses huit Grandes Écoles publiques et ses deux Graduate Schools affiliées, il constitue le premier institut public dédié à la formation des ingénieurs et des managers. Ensemble, nous imaginons et construisons un avenir durable en formant les leaders qui façonneront les transitions de demain. Every day, we rely on information that's been independently verified, from financial statements to the products we buy, to the sustainability claims companies make. Behind that trust are audit and finance professionals who examine evidence, verify information and hold organizations accountable. At DataSnipper, we build AI solutions that empower those professionals. By making evidence easier to trace and verify, we help them focus on the judgment and expertise that make their work so important. For our product and engineering team, this is where things get exciting. In audit, a plausible answer isn't good enough. Every output has to be explainable and traceable back to its source. We've just launched a brand new agentic platform, Alwin by DataSnipper. jobs.description: About us Rentman is a B2B SaaS scale-up building a smart, powerful operations management platform to support event and media production teams. Our users plan everything from small shoots to massive festivals in 70+ countries, and they all rely on Rentman to keep their gear, people, and timing perfectly in sync. We’re based in Utrecht (NL) with a second office in Toronto (CA), and our 100+ team members work in a culture that’s open, flat, and inclusive, where curiosity drives us, ownership matters, and everyone has the freedom to challenge ideas and make an impact. Check out our public roadmap to see what’s coming next! Mission of this role Thousands of rental companies run their business on Rentman, and many of them depend on it talking smoothly to the rest of their stack: accounting packages, webshops, calendars, and our public API. When an integration breaks, invoices don’t sync, bookings go missing, and customers notice fast. As Senior QA Specialist for the Integrations team, you make sure every release reaches those customers without regressions. You own the team’s test strategy and lead the move from manual release-day testing to an automated, shift-left suite. This is a role with real ownership: you shape how the team thinks about quality, and you grow the practice as our integrations platform grows. Because so much of the squad's work is shaped by what those users need, whoever leads it works closely with the Product Manager on what we build as well as on how we build it. jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description: Hi, I'm Maria , Interim VP Product at FeedbackFruits. 👋 FeedbackFruits is moving from a founder-led company to a product-led one, which means Product is taking on a much bigger role in deciding what we build and why. Before stepping into this role I worked as a PM here myself, with the squads and within the details, so I know how much depends on the PMs who work with those squads every day. I'm building a team of PMs who care about the craft: who do the discovery before committing to a build, make clear calls about priorities, and follow their work through to how teachers end up using it. I'm looking for a Product Manager to lead one of our squads and own how teachers go from setting up their first activity to making FeedbackFruits part of how they teach every week. That means helping instructors see which students are stuck while there's still time to step in, making grading faster and less painful, and making it easy for a great activity to travel from one teacher to the next across an institution. You'll decide what the squad works on and why, and you'll have the room to set that direction yourself. The EdTech market is tough right now, so every product decision has to earn its place. I like working this way, because a PM with sharp judgment sees their impact fast. You’ll also help shape how product works here as we raise the bar together: how we find the right problems, make calls and bring people along, and what great looks like for the PMs who join after you. jobs.title: Software Engineer - Ruby on Rails
jobs.description: We're hiring a full-stack engineer to help us build the next version of FeedbackFruits. We believe in engineers who stay close to the product: domain experts who pay attention to how users actually behave and use the platform. Most of the work comes down to one thing: making the product better. We rethink each feature from the user's perspective and rebuild it on stronger foundations, together with our designers and product managers. We modernise the stack as we go, moving from Rails + Ember.js to Rails + Hotwire. There's deeper technical work alongside it, on performance, stability, and the platform, all in service of a product that feels faster and more reliable. Stabilisation and simplification are our top concerns, from both a product and an engineering standpoint. We'd rather fix root causes for the long term than patch symptoms, even when patching would be quicker. Our long-term aim is to get closer to our users by shipping faster, moving from one monthly release with regular hotfixes toward continuous delivery. We've also adopted agentic coding and integrations to sharpen how we work, and we value multipliers: engineers who raise the people around them and put the team before their own output. jobs.title: Financial Administrator
jobs.description: Hi, I'm Alex, Finance Manager at FeedbackFruits. 👋 Our Finance team is ramping up over the next couple of years, and we are looking for someone to join the team on a 24-32 hour basis ! Finance here runs across two entities, a Dutch BV and a US Corp, each with its own invoicing, tax and banking rules. Our customers are universities all over the world, so the work ranges from a straightforward Dutch invoice to a US procurement portal with its own supplier onboarding forms and submission rules. The role is broader than most financial administration jobs at this level, and we are searching for someone who's ready to own it. I'm looking for a Financial Administrator to take on our day-to-day operations: billing and collections on the receivables side, supplier invoices and payment runs on the payables side, and the Finance mailbox where everything is coordinated. A lot of our processes are still manual, with limited documented processes. You'd be doing the work and improving it at the same time, formalising operating procedures as you go. The ideal team member is someone who notices when a workflow is clumsy, and is proactive in addressing it. We're a small team of two, and we support the wider organisation with a vast range of topics. You'd work closely with our New Business and Partner Success teams when it comes to billing, and with our Marketing team when it comes to purchasing. When an invoice goes out on time, a university pays on schedule or a purchasing inquiry is resolved ahead of an event, that's visible, and it will be thanks to you. Financial administration can often be limited to a narrow scope of topics within a larger team. If you're eager to get the full picture of operations in a company with an international customer base, this is the right place for it. What you'll do: Send out sales invoices on time. jobs.title: Senior Delivery Recruiter Tech (m/w/d), 180° Delivery, 100 % Remote
jobs.description: Die meisten Recruiter sind Postboten. Wir nicht. Die Branche ist kaputt. Hunderte Kandidaten werden angespammt, CVs blind rausgeschickt, und dann wird gebetet. Das Ergebnis sind genervte Kunden, verbrannte Talente und Placement-Quoten zum Weinen. Bei Recruitment Circle machen wir Delivery anders: mit Daten, Psychologie und einem Auswahlverfahren, das Blender aussortiert, bevor der Kunde sie sieht. Das Ergebnis: 7 von 10 Kandidaten, die wir einreichen, landen im Interview. Der Markt liegt bei 10–20 %. Dein Job: reines Delivery. Du bekommst die Mandate. Du lieferst die Menschen. Punkt. Dein Erfolg wird an Placements gemessen, nicht an Stunden: Monat 1: Du steuerst die Prozesse eines Key-Accounts eigenständig. Monat 2: Deine erste Vermittlung ist durch. Monat 6: Du hast 60.000 € Umsatz geliefert. Monat 12: Du stehst bei 250.000 € Jahresumsatz und bist eine Bank in der Delivery. Was du mitbringst 3+ Jahre Agentur-Recruiting , idealerweise bei einem kleineren Personaldienstleister. Du weißt, was Dienstleistung heißt. Sourcing-Skills: LinkedIn Recruiter, Xing, GitHub, Stack Overflow, und Lust auf neue Tools wie Juicebox und Clay. Du findest die passiven Talente, die sonst keiner erreicht. Biss im Interview: Du bohrst nach, bis die echte Performance auf dem Tisch liegt. Augenhöhe: Du sprichst mit CTOs und Practice Leads als Experte, nicht als Bittsteller. Extreme Ownership: Bei dir fällt nichts runter. Ein schweres Profil ist für dich eine Challenge, kein Grund zu jammern. Was du bekommst Geld, das Leistung abbildet: 50–60k Fix, 5–20 % Provision ab dem ersten Euro, 100k+ OTE für alle, die liefern. 100 % Remote, deutschlandweit: Kein Pendeln, keine Präsenzpflicht. Tech-Stack, der arbeitet: Recruit CRM, Apollo, Clay, Juicebox und eigene Automatisierungs-Workflows. Wir bauen die Maschine, du bedienst die Hebel. RC-Masterclass: Du lernst, Lebensläufe zu sezieren und A-Player von Blendern zu trennen Zeitnah verfügbar? Umso besser. Schick uns dein LinkedIn-Profil und deine Place

jobs.title: Senior Product Engineer (Software) (m/w/d)
jobs.description: Roger is the operating system for dental practices. We automate the work dental teams shouldn’t be doing by hand – from treatment plans to patient communication to revenue optimization – and we plug directly into the practice management systems (PMS) that German practices already run on. We’re early, well-funded, and moving fast. We’re looking for a Senior Product Engineer who wants to own a product area end to end: understand the practice’s problem, decide what to build, ship it, run it, and improve it with real usage data. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - Data Platform (m/w/d)
jobs.description: About Nu Nu serves more than 140 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services. Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability. Visit our Institutional Page You will join an engineering squad in our Berlin office working on distributed systems and platform infrastructure. Our products serve analytics engineers and business teams across the company, but this is primarily a systems engineering role (roughly 75% core software systems engineering, 25% data architecture). We value engineering depth: we build internal distributed solutions and understand the runtimes underneath, rather than only orchestrating managed tools. As a Senior Software Engineer you will shape the architecture of our low-level infrastructure, orchestration frameworks and storage engines. You will lead technical design, resolve systemic bottlenecks in compute and streaming layers, and mentor engineers across squads, working with colleagues in Berlin, the US and Latin America. jobs.description: We're looking for experienced software engineers to build AI coding tasks from a codebase they know well. US$1,000 per task, and you can do as many tasks as you want. Run your task against leading AI models until strong models often fail but a skilled engineer can clearly solve it. Review. A reviewer checks your task and you revise it. Most tasks take more than one round. Next task. Once your task is accepted, start another. jobs.title: Software Engineer AI Coding Tasks
jobs.description: We're looking for experienced software engineers to build AI coding tasks from a codebase they know well. US$1,000 per task, and you can do as many tasks as you want. You turn a real change from a repository you know into a task that today's best AI coding models struggle with: hard for the models, but fair for a skilled engineer. Your tasks are used to measure and train AI coding models. Remote, any location. US$1,000 per task that passes review. Minimum of one task a week, about 10 hours a week. How it works Apply. Complete a short screener interview and upload your resume. Propose. Once you're selected, pick a change from a repository you know and submit a short proposal. We approve it or suggest a better candidate. Build. In our platform, set up the repository as it was before the change, then write the brief, the correct solution and the grading checks. Stress-test. Try lazy, incorrect and shortcut solutions and make sure your checks catch them. Model testing. Run your task against leading AI models until strong models often fail but a skilled engineer can clearly solve it. Review. A reviewer checks your task and you revise it. Most tasks take more than one round. Next task. Once your task is accepted, start another. Requirements 2+ years of professional software engineering Code merged into a public open-source repository, ideally one you know well.
